scope: Each of the 29 production requests (validation/2026-10-04-production-gear-swaps/requests) with one change: an equipment slot takes an item another production request wears in the slot Go equips it into, where the UI's canEquipItem lets the class wear it; a worn item takes an enchant another request uses in that slot; a consumable takes another request's choice (weapon imbues only within a class); or the race takes another the class can be. Each request also runs unchanged.

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID

notes: Fixed in this branch from earlier failures: a player without a mana bar exported the Mana stat a Flask of Distilled Wisdom adds; mana ticks ran only for the player, not for a mana pet such as the Dragon's Call whelp of a Warrior or Rogue; mana gems, Dark Sacrifice, Shield Specialization and Fel Energy read the maximum mana prepared at reset instead of Go's current MaxMana.
The production requests wear no trinkets, so no trinket swaps arise.

Run against the coordinator branch at 076116f, with the owners' fixes for Thistle Tea, Hack and Slash, the Paladin and Warrior Goblin Sapper Charge, the Dragon's Call tanks, Hands of Power and the Warrior robes merged. What remains: Dragon's Call adds a second pet, which the runtime does not simulate; conjured items that drop Bear Form; and the pinned Go engine's Ignite crash on a Mage's Goblin Sapper Charge.
